test_overview: Evaluation of the "My Messages" test plan against the Team Chat app. Steps 1-2 passed (login as Alice lands on #general with a My Messages nav entry plus channel/DM navigation; My Messages view opens showing a proper empty state). Step 3 FATAL FAILURE: after Alice sent a DM to Bob and Bob replied with two messages, clicking "My Messages" in context_A never rendered the message rows (0 .my-message-row elements). A client-side polling bug re-appends already-visible messages every 2s (dozens of duplicated DM bubbles accumulated in both contexts) and its synchronous duplicate-append loop starves the async My Messages render, leaving stale DM DOM under the "My Messages" title. The fatal verification "Bob's two DM messages appear in the My Messages list" failed, so per the scoring rules the entire test plan fails and steps 4-9 were not executed. Final score: 7/76.

steps.description: Step 1 test_my_messages_entry_visible: PASSED. Alice logged in and landed on #general; sidebar navigation includes 'My Messages' under ACTIVITY, plus access to #general (CHANNELS) and Direct Messages (DIRECT MESSAGES + New Message button). 4/4.

Step 2 test_my_messages_initially_empty: PASSED. Clicking 'My Messages' opened the view (title 'My Messages') showing empty-state indicator 'No messages yet. Messages from your DMs and threads you participate in will show up here.' 3/3.

Step 3 test_dm_messages_appear_in_my_messages: FATAL FAILURE, 0/12. Actions done correctly (Alice DM'd Bob; Bob replied with two messages in the same DM). On clicking 'My Messages' in context_A the required rows never rendered (0 .my-message-row elements) - a polling bug endlessly duplicates already-visible messages and starves the My Messages render, leaving stale DM bubbles under the 'My Messages' title. Bob's two DM messages never appeared in the My Messages list; test plan failed.
